flows.name: Global entry point
notes: The list is the only entry point that opens the modal empty — the detail page pre-fills it.
Screens captured from the fixture pages in public/fixtures/. In a real app they would come from a /dev/screens harness.

screens.title: Records list
screens.description: Whole page, nav bar included — the reader needs to see where the user was before the modal opened.
notes: Rows are sorted by last change, not by state.
The chevron opens the detail page; the row body does nothing.

hotspots.label: New record
hotspots.note: Opens the modal with nothing pre-filled

hotspots.label: Row chevron
hotspots.note: Opens the detail page — see the Detail page flow

screens.title: New record — empty
screens.description: Name and owner. Both are editable later, which is why there is no warning about getting it wrong.
notes: Fields validate on blur, not on submit.
Continue stays enabled and shows inline errors — deliberate, so the user isn't left guessing why a disabled button won't move.

screens.title: Confirm details
screens.description: Read-only recap. Creating the record notifies the owner.
notes: Back returns to the form with the values kept — it does not reset.

flows.name: Detail page
flows.description: Second entry point: a single record.
notes: Opens the modal with the record pre-selected, so the empty form is never shown here.

screens.title: Record detail
screens.description: The same primary CTA as the list, in the same place — it is the only control that opens the modal.
notes: The state pill is a label, not a control. Changing state happens from the actions menu.

screens.title: New record from detail
notes: Identical modal — the entry point only decides what it opens with.

flows.name: Edge cases & states
flows.description: Everything the happy path doesn't show.
notes: A lane with no transitions is laid out as a plain row rather than a journey.
Both states below are worth capturing because neither is reachable from the happy path.

screens.title: Loading
notes: Skeleton keeps the row height, so the page doesn't jump when data lands.

screens.title: Empty list
notes: First-run state. The CTA moves into the card and the one in the header is dropped.
Copy is placeholder — needs a pass before ship.
